# D332509 Thunderbird calendar selector review, workflow, and fixup recovery

For the selected-calendar swatch, `cal.view.colorTracker` owns live `--calendar-<formatted-id>-backcolor` variables. The accepted D332509 fix renamed `selectCalendarColor` to `selectCalendarColorId` and renders `var(--calendar-${cal.view.formatStringForCSSRule(calendarId)}-backcolor)`, avoiding a copied Redux color; register the tracker in browser fixtures that exercise calendar colors. [Task 4]

Scope: calendar.
